title: Escrow
fundDialogBody: Payment protection coming soon. We are preparing an integrated payment and transaction-protection system. Current funding is simulated only and does not hold real funds.
disputeDialogBody: Describe the issue clearly. Funds will be frozen until admin review.
escrowHistorySubtitle: Libyan Freelance does not receive or hold project funds at this stage. Payment is arranged directly between client and freelancer. Platform payment protection will be introduced later on {brand}.
noTransactions: No platform-held payments yet — and none are required during this launch phase.
directPaymentBanner: Payment is currently made directly between the client and freelancer. Libyan Freelance does not receive or hold project funds at this stage.
